summary: The proposal lacks several mandatory structural components, an AI transparency statement, and required figures, and contains numerous methodological and writing issues. While the subject matter is promising, extensive revisions are needed before the proposal can be submitted.

findings.title: Missing Introduction Section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Introduction section, which is required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Motivation Section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain a dedicated Motivation section, so the required visionary discussion is absent.

findings.title: Missing Objective Section with Subsections
findings.description: The proposal lacks an Objective section that starts with a short introduction, a bullet list of 3‑4 high‑level objectives, and separate subsections for each objective.

findings.title: Problem Section Presents Solutions
findings.description: The Problem section includes statements that suggest a solution, which is prohibited; it should only describe the problem and its negative impact.

locations.quote: The CI server **should be migrated** to the VC server. Furthermore, it **should be possible to adjust the build plan** after the task has been assigned.

findings.title: Missing AI Transparency Statement
findings.description: The proposal does not contain the required AI Transparency Statement describing AI tools used, their purposes, applied sections, and author verification of AI‑generated text.

findings.title: Insufficient Figures and Missing Required UML Diagram
findings.description: The proposal includes only one figure and lacks any UML diagram, whereas the guidelines require at least two figures and at least one UML diagram.

findings.title: Figure Not Referenced in Text
findings.description: Figure 1 is presented but never cited within the main body of the proposal.

findings.title: Writing Style Issues: Passive Voice and Undefined Abbreviation
findings.description: Multiple sentences use passive voice, reducing clarity, and the abbreviation "API" is introduced without definition.

locations.quote: as the build plan **is fetched** from the API on each run.

locations.section: System Requirements and Top Level Design

findings.title: Iteration Length Too Short
findings.description: The schedule lists tasks by individual weeks, resulting in iterations of only one week, which is shorter than the required 2‑4 week iteration length.

findings.title: Non‑Measurable Deliverable – Requirements Sprint
findings.description: The entry "Requirements (parallel to prototype implementation)" does not specify a concrete, measurable deliverable and constitutes a vague requirements‑gathering activity, which is prohibited.

findings.title: Horizontal Feature Split
findings.description: Work items such as "Requirements" and "Models" are split horizontally across layers rather than describing end‑to‑end vertically integrated features.

findings.title: Documentation Writing Task Included in Schedule
findings.description: The schedule lists a documentation writing activity, which is not allowed in a development‑focused schedule.

locations.quote: – 2nd week: **Documentation for installation and confguration of Artemis with GitLab CI**

findings.title: Formatting Issues: Short Paragraph and Heading Capitalization
findings.description: The abstract contains a single‑line paragraph that does not meet the required length, and several headings use sentence case instead of title case.

findings.description: The schedule lists isolated weekly tasks without grouping them into 2‑4 week iterative sprints, resembling a waterfall plan rather than an agile approach.
